zyd232 LLMGenerator.description: Generate text from any OpenAI-compatible server. Supports multiple reference images, videos and audio.

config_name.name: Config Name
config_name.tooltip: Name for this preset; illegal characters are removed automatically

base_url.name: Base URL
base_url.tooltip: AI service URL, e.g. Ollama or vLLM endpoint

api_key.name: API Key
api_key.tooltip: API key, or ENV:var_name to read from environment

model_select.name: Model Select
model_select.tooltip: Dropdown to select a vision model. Selection will fill the 'model' field below.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Vision model name (free input). Can be typed manually or selected from the dropdown above.

model_NoVision_select.name: Text-Only Model Select
model_NoVision_select.tooltip: Dropdown to select a text-only model. Selection will fill the 'model_NoVision' field below.

model_NoVision.name: Text-Only Model
model_NoVision.tooltip: Text-only model name (free input). Used when no image/video/audio is provided.

system_prompt.name: System Prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: System prompt that defines the AI's role and behavior

user_prompt.name: User Prompt
user_prompt.tooltip: Your question or instruction for the AI

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.tooltip: Randomness: higher is more creative, lower is more stable

top_k.name: Top K
top_k.tooltip: Pick next word from top K candidates

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed for reproducibility, -1 for random

context_length.name: Context Length
context_length.tooltip: Context window size. Set to -1 or 0 to omit num_ctx/n_ctx and let the server use its default context length

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.tooltip: Timeout in seconds for the LLM generation request

reasoning_effort_select.name: Reasoning Effort Select
reasoning_effort_select.tooltip: Dropdown to pick a reasoning effort. Selection will fill the 'reasoning_effort' field below.

reasoning_effort.name: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.tooltip: Reasoning effort sent to the server (requires the LLM server to enable its Jinja template). Can be typed manually or selected from the dropdown above. 'off'/'none' disables thinking.

separate_thinking.name: Separate Thinking
separate_thinking.tooltip: Separate AI's thinking process from final answer

think_start_tag.name: Think Start Tag
think_start_tag.tooltip: Opening tag to mark the start of thinking content

think_end_tag.name: Think End Tag
think_end_tag.tooltip: Closing tag to mark the end of thinking content

clean_comfy_vram_before_gen.name: Clean VRAM Before Gen
clean_comfy_vram_before_gen.tooltip: Clear ComfyUI VRAM before generation to avoid OOM

unload_after_gen.name: Unload After Gen
unload_after_gen.tooltip: Unload model after generation to free VRAM

unload_endpoint.name: Unload Endpoint
unload_endpoint.tooltip: API endpoint path for unloading the model. 'auto' uses the endpoint preset for the selected Server Type; a custom value is used as-is

unload_timeout.name: Unload Timeout
unload_timeout.tooltip: Max seconds to wait for the server to finish unloading. Uses a hybrid strategy: sends the unload request synchronously, then polls /v1/models to confirm the model is released, preventing downstream nodes from OOMing while the server is still unloading. The timeout prevents the node from blocking the workflow indefinitely if the server is slow.

server_type.name: Server Type
server_type.tooltip: LLM server type. Determines how unload, reasoning_effort and payload are sent to the server. 'auto' probes the server automatically

cache_prompt.name: Cache Prompt
cache_prompt.tooltip: Cache prompts to speed up repeated requests

auto_lock.name: Auto Lock
auto_lock.tooltip: When enabled, the Streaming Text panel automatically locks the result once generation completes

video_fps.name: Video FPS
video_fps.tooltip: Sampling density per reference video. Assumes the source video is 24fps: keeps video_fps frames per 24 source frames (n = total * video_fps/24), then capped by max_video_frames. Default 1.0.

max_video_frames.name: Max Video Frames
max_video_frames.tooltip: Maximum number of frames sent per video (to avoid exceeding context length). Set to -1 or 0 to disable the cap and send all frames.

enable_audio.name: Enable Audio
enable_audio.tooltip: Encode and send audio references to the API (only if the model supports audio)

use_locked.name: Use Locked
use_locked.tooltip: When true, skip LLM generation and return the locked result

locked_text.name: Locked Text
locked_text.tooltip: Locked final text returned when use_locked is true

locked_reasoning.name: Locked Reasoning
locked_reasoning.tooltip: Locked reasoning text returned when use_locked is true

zyd232 LLMUnload.description: Send an unload signal to the LLM Server to release the model from VRAM. All parameters come from the config preset saved by the LLM Text Generator node. Before using this node, first confirm that the LLM Text Generator node's configuration can run 'Unload After Gen' correctly, because this node's proper operation relies on the parameters stored in the config preset being correctly configured. Acts like a reroute: the any input is passed through unchanged to the any output.

config_select.name: Config Preset
config_select.tooltip: Choose a saved server preset. All unload parameters (base_url, api_key, model, server_type, unload_endpoint, unload_timeout) are read from this preset, which is saved by the LLM Text Generator node.

model_select.name: Model Select
model_select.tooltip: Dropdown to select the model to unload. Selection fills the 'model' field below.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model name to unload (free input). Can be typed manually or selected from the dropdown above. Leave empty to fall back to the model stored in the config preset.

any_input.name: Any Input
any_input.tooltip: Optional. Any value passed through unchanged. Lets this node be inserted anywhere in the workflow.

any_output.name: Any Output
any_output.tooltip: The input value passed through unchanged.

zyd232 ImagesPixelsCompare.description: Compare two images at the pixel level to check whether they are exactly the same.

if_same_output.name: If Same Output
if_same_output.tooltip: When true, outputs true if the images are identical; when false, inverts the logic

zyd232 MaskBatchBlend.description: Blend multiple masks together into a single mask.

operation.name: Operation
operation.tooltip: Blend operation: add, max, or average

zyd232_SavePreviewImages.description: Save images to the output directory, optionally generating previews and workflow JSON.

save_image.name: Save Image
save_image.tooltip: Whether to save the images to disk

save_workflow_as_json.name: Save Workflow as JSON
save_workflow_as_json.tooltip: Whether to save the workflow as a JSON file

meta_data_png.name: Write PNG Metadata
meta_data_png.tooltip: Whether to write prompt info into PNG metadata

custom_path.name: Custom Path
custom_path.tooltip: Custom save path, supports %date and %time placeholders
